data.body: Fixed in 02cb77f706. Two surgical changes: (1) worktree-cleanup.sh has_stashes() now scopes to the worktree's current branch via WIP-on/On-<branch> filter; (2) worktree-create.sh count regex tightened to worktree-[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6} to exclude agent-* from the >=10 trigger. Tests: tests/scripts/test_worktree_lifecycle_fixes.py (3 d5c1 tests GREEN); 21 existing worktree-cleanup tests unregressed. Parallel-session safety preserved: the live-PID lock check and is_claude_active lsof guard remain in place.
